facts.quote: You can also get some collection updates inside Memorial Caverns

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: An official freerealms.com news post promoting the Memorial Caverns in Sanctuary, a museum on Pixie and Sanctuary history located north of the World Tree. It names the combat quests Darvon's Descent and Forgotten Caves, mentions collection updates, and notes Sanctuary Rare Exploration coins can be found inside. Members can talk to Tori about becoming a volunteer guide.
